'''C-06X''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] unit created by the [[Colicoid Creation Nest/Legends|Colicoid Creation Nest]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was acquired by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] to serve as a courier for [[Darth Malgus]] and inform Imperial heroes of the upcoming [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoid]] war games.
